internal.label: Internal: account team and leadership
internal.description: Readers inside the organization that owns the engagement or the product. Internal-only sources such as CRM records, trackers, internal mail, chat and meeting transcripts may be used, and every output carries an Internal marking.

intents.text: Account health, consumption, renewal and true-down risk that leadership must act on
Blocked work, escalations and partner dependencies that need an internal owner
Named owners, dates and the next internal actions to unblock progress
Engagement stage, use case status and where the account team needs help
New signals from the customer this week and what they change for the account plan
Product and platform choices, their trade-offs and what they mean for our roadmap and investment
Governance, security, licensing and compliance obligations our teams must meet
Market and competitive change that affects our strategy and priorities
The decision leadership needs to make and the evidence behind it

external.label: External: customer and partner executives
external.description: Readers outside the organization, such as the customer's executives. Only public or customer-shared sources may be cited; terms, names and figures that appear only in internal sources are leakage.

intents.text: Business outcomes and measurable value delivered for the customer
Progress toward the customer's goals, milestones and adoption
Joint next steps and the decisions needed from the customer's leaders
Risks to the customer's timeline and how they are being mitigated
Product capabilities and roadmap that matter to the customer's priorities
Architecture and integration choices and their trade-offs for the customer's teams
Security, governance and compliance assurances the customer needs before adopting
Industry and market context that affects the customer's strategy
